name: Motorradfahrer
intro: Für Biker: fettes Motorrad-Motiv mit deinem Spruch, Name und Tour/Club. Optional ein Foto deiner eigenen Maschine hochladen – oder die Art des Motorrads wählen.
variations:
central motif: a powerful classic cruiser motorcycle seen from a dynamic front angle, wings behind
central motif: a sports bike leaning deep into a mountain curve, speed lines
central motif: a chopper with long forks on an endless straight road, sunset
central motif: a big adventure touring bike with panniers on a gravel track in the mountains
central motif: a vintage cafe racer in front of a brick wall
central motif: a scrambler jumping over a hill, dirt flying
central motif: a vintage motorcycle engine (V-twin) with flames and a piston, drawn like an emblem
central motif: a skull wearing a motorcycle helmet with goggles, wings at the sides
central motif: a group of three bikes riding in formation on a winding road through hills
central motif: a motorcycle wheel with wings and a winding road ribbon
central motif: a rider's silhouette from behind on a bike, road ahead, mountains and a big moon
central motif: a classic bike parked in front of a mountain pass sign, curvy road below
suggestions:
Leben auf zwei Rädern
Kurven sind mein Zuhause
Ride free
Vollgas ins Wochenende
Zwei Räder bewegen die Seele
Bremsen ist Vertrauenssache

fields.label: Spruch
fields.placeholder: z. B. Leben auf zwei Rädern

fields.label: Art des Motorrads (falls kein Foto)
fields.hint: Ohne Foto: wähle die Art deiner Maschine – sonst entsteht eine zufällige.

upload.label: Foto deines Motorrads (optional)
upload.hint: Lade ein Foto deiner eigenen Maschine hoch – Otto zeichnet dann genau die als Motiv. Ohne Foto entsteht ein Motiv nach der gewählten Art.

prompt:
Bold biker / motorcycle T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

Big lettering carries the main text, which reads exactly "{spruch}".
[[A small line reads exactly "{name}".]]
[[A curved line reads exactly "{ort}".]]

The central motif and the arrangement follow the variation given below - a different picture every time. Rebellious, free, on-the-road look.

Style: vintage motorcycle screen print, heavy black outlines, chrome and fire palette (black, red, orange, silver, cream), halftone shading, no photorealism, no gradients.
